title: Common schema
text: AEGIS-X converts findings from GuardDuty, Security Hub, Sentinel, Defender for Cloud and Security Command Center into one common JSON schema. The schema keeps the raw provider payload, the native severity and the native identifier next to the normalized fields so analysts can always return to the original evidence.

title: De-duplication
text: Duplicate findings are collapsed using deterministic finding identifiers. Security Hub re-reports GuardDuty findings, so its normalizer parses the GuardDuty finding ARN and records the equivalent identifier in related_finding_ids. The pipeline keeps the earliest first_seen and the latest last_seen.

title: Correlation
text: Correlation links findings that occur within a 120 minute window and share weighted keys. Resource, principal and threat intelligence indicator each score 3, while account and MITRE technique each score 1. Two findings are linked when their score is at least 2, and incidents are connected components of those links.

title: Idempotency
text: EventBridge and SQS can deliver the same event more than once. The ingestion Lambda writes each finding to an S3 key derived from its finding identifier, so a redelivery overwrites the object instead of creating a duplicate. The ingested_at timestamp refreshes on replay and nothing else changes.

title: Severity
text: GuardDuty severity bands are Low from 1 to 3.9, Medium from 4 to 6.9, High from 7 to 8.9 and Critical from 9 upward. Each normalizer maps its native scale onto the common severity labels.

title: Cost safety
text: Every billable resource sits behind an enable_ variable that defaults to false. A policy test parses the Terraform with python-hcl2 and fails if a master switch defaults to true or if a resource ignores the switches.

title: Storage security
text: Terraform S3 buckets must have a public access block, KMS encryption and versioning. KMS keys must have rotation enabled. The account level S3 public access block is codified in the governance module and protected with prevent_destroy.

title: Identity
text: Administrative access uses an IAM Identity Center role instead of root credentials. A read only script checks that the root user has MFA enabled and no access keys, that CloudTrail is healthy and that GuardDuty is enabled.

title: NEXUS agents
text: NEXUS AI is a FastAPI application with three agent domains: enterprise, personal and cybersecurity. An orchestrator routes each request to a domain agent, and a decision engine assigns priority and risk.

title: NEXUS and AEGIS-X
text: The NEXUS cybersecurity agent can summarize and explain AEGIS-X incidents through a read only integration. It has no cloud credentials and no ability to execute actions, so any response automation would require human approval.

title: NEXUS retrieval
text: NEXUS stores document chunks in Qdrant with embeddings from the nomic-embed-text model served by Ollama. Search filters by user identifier and applies a minimum similarity score of 0.15 by default.

title: Testing
text: Tests include per-normalizer unit tests, schema validation of every output, an end-to-end flow from raw provider payloads to incidents, and recovery tests for partial failure and dead letter queue replay. Tests were mutation checked by deliberately breaking controls.

title: Real data lesson
text: Running the GuardDuty normalizer on real findings from the CLI failed because the CLI returns PascalCase keys while EventBridge returns camelCase. The fix folds keys on a working copy while leaving the raw payload untouched.
